venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Sunny with highs near 80 and lows reaching the 50s overnight
venues.notes_summary: Steady start to the Friday at CC ATL. Nice weather brought people out on the beltline and past the open door. Guest flow picked up around 8:30pm and stayed steady till about 12am. Peak volume around 10pm as usual, but no significant late-night push around 12/12:30am. Kya from Il Premio said their volume was also meh — a chill Friday for the neighborhood. Opener cut shortly after closers arrived. Mid stayed on till just after 12am. All guests out by 2:15am.
maintenance_flags: Well 200 leak is back — pool of liquid requiring multiple towel cleanups through the night
eightysixed: 3 Taverns Prince of Pils (now running Sierra Nevada Pilsner)

highlights.text: Well 200 leak back with a vengeance — needs investigation (possibly bar rinser or H2O/sparkling lines)
Peak around 10pm; steady from 8:30pm-12am. No significant late-night push

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: Very slow in house until about 9:30pm. Picked up but never got too full — stayed steady from that point until later than usual. A decent amount of folks in house right up to the end. 10-top no-showed their 7pm reservation. Tay had a minor finger cut that was wrapped and he finished the shift. Decent food sales toward the end. Linda Tan (old teammate of KE from ~6 years ago) came in with friends and particularly loved the Daisy de Manzana.

highlights.text: 10-top no-show at 7pm; minor staff injury (finger cut, finished shift)
Slow start, picked up at 9:30pm and stayed steady through close

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Busy morning from the start with a steady pace and consistent flow of service throughout. Strong street traffic on Broughton brought many new faces along with MAX guests. Great start to the weekend! Good business through happy hour into a great dinner start with walk-ins filling the dining room until reservations took off around 7pm. Solid rush at 8:30 kept bar and floor busy until kitchen close. A few more walk-ins after 10 — most headed downstairs to keep the party going. Sun Club had its busiest day of the week with beautiful weather. Hot Eye notes: 0.

highlights.text: Sun Club busiest day of the week; all four sub-venues active
Strong street traffic on Broughton; solid 8:30 rush kept team busy through kitchen close

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.notes_summary: WOW what a night. Full rooms all night — turn and burn. Lots of big parties and 2-top walk-ins made seating easy. Ryan and Natalie did great tackling the waitlist. Implemented QR code waitlist for upstairs — working great! Continued pulling people physically there downstairs to speed up instead of relying solely on text-backs. A few DNLs but found solutions for all. Kept SR open til 1am — it was cranking. Snack menus driving great late-night food sales. Huge shoutout to Chef and Josh. Sewer smell + weird fishy smell plagued the evening with several guest complaints and a couple guests who decided not to stay because of it.
maintenance_flags: Severe sewer/fishy smell all night — guest complaints, some guests left because of it

highlights.text: Severe sewer/fishy smell — guest complaints, some guests left
Both rooms cranking all night; QR code waitlist working great upstairs

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Steady smooth Friday night with a full staff of rock stars! Pacing was fantastic and everyone on top of their game. Lots of celebrations tonight including VIPs bringing family and TRH staff celebrating a 21st birthday with their first drink at D&C. 6A had a chill night with some lulls and no-shows. Kitchen had a fuego night with Archer and Isais — orders all the way till the end yet went so smoothly. Carey celebrating 8-year anniversary with the team. AM sales $1,128.62, PM D&C $16,486.84, Garden/6A $2,713.02.

highlights.text: Full staff of rock stars; fantastic pacing all night
Carey's 8-year anniversary; VIP celebrations and first-drink 21st birthday

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: Slow start, slow finish, packed middle. Large parties boosted first couple turns. Room half empty by midnight with trickling foot traffic. Strong enthusiasts kept check averages high. Courtney and family visited during first turn. Top sellers: Masari, Cielo Asilo, Root & Rye. Door had line at open, full by 7pm, smooth flips with long waitlist of midsized tables. Foot traffic died after 10pm flip. Three no-shows charged (2 of 3).

highlights.text: Packed middle section; slow bookends. Strong enthusiast engagement kept check avg high

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.notes_summary: Full private event night — $16,802 in event sales with 79 attendees. BOH team did great job with event food, all dishes timely. Heard many compliments on food offerings. Great communication throughout. Some guests requested photos with staff. May need more large format plates for future events.

highlights.text: Above target — $16,802 vs $10,398 target (+61.6%) — full private event
Guests raved about atmosphere, F&B, and staff
